blocks.text: Philippine delegate Bea Millan-Windorski was a scene-stealer at the 2026 Miss Universe’s “Runway to the Universe” showcase, impressing pageant fans with her stage presence and pasarela prowess. The Filipino-American beauty queen commanded the runway in a black-and-white polka dot dress by Puerto Rican fashion designer Javier Arnalod, as seen in the clips shared by the Miss Universe Philippines organization on its social media pages on Nov. 18. “A celebration of the host country’s artistry and creative vision, her look brings the spirit of a queen into the spotlight as she continues to make her mark at the 75th Miss Universe,” the […]...
